summary: Character-class query that tests a character code against the digit classification bit. In single-byte mode it masks the per-code classification table entry with 4; in multi-byte mode it delegates to the lookup-table conversion fallback with the same mask value 4.

operations.description: Mode guard on the character-encoding state: when cbMultiByte <= 1 the code page is single-byte and the static classification table applies directly; otherwise the multi-byte conversion path is taken.
Single-byte path: read the classification table entry off_5E69C8[0][CharType] and keep only the bit selected by mask 4 (binary bit 2, the digit class bit).
Multi-byte path: delegate the classification to CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback, passing the character code and the class mask 4.
Return the masked classification flags from the selected path.

unresolved: Digit-class interpretation of mask 4 is DERIVED from the mask value; the packet does not name the classification flags.
Callers include PPMP6ImageDecoder (0x00501E39) in addition to sub_48B560; the calling context is not part of this packet.
